edits.before: OI-1 previously rested on an inventory of how people say they signal romantic interest, measured in the general population. This is the source that makes the open issue honest, and its finding points somewhere useful. Uncertainty is not a new problem requiring new machinery. Week 3 says an envelope marks a place where the sender doesn't know the answer. Week 9 says the rate limit is the move for when you can't predict the other person's next step. The named obstacle in OI-1 is the one the course spent two weeks on.
edits.after: For OI-1, the reported uncertainty gives a connection to weeks 3 and 9. It does not establish that the course's decoder or rate-limit model resolves difficulties in romantic relationships.
edits.reason: Remove drafting history and a claim of sufficient machinery; make the cross-reference without promising that the course has solved the reported problem.
